name: Seared Rosemary Chicken Thighs with Creamy Mushrooms & Peas

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add chicken in a single layer and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, and loosely cover with aluminum foil (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
While the chicken browns, peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Add mushrooms to the pot and cook until golden brown and tender, 5-7 minutes.
While the mushrooms cook, place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw.
Add peas, cream, and spices to the pot; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml heavy cream
1 ½ tsp rosemary
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return chicken to the pot (overlapping the chicken thighs slightly, if necessary), along with any accumulated juices. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 10-12 minutes.
When the chicken is done, add Parmesan to the pot and stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken and veggies between plates, spooning sauce on top. Enjoy!
